# Fantasy Trade Target

Fantasy Trade Target publishes free, deterministic fantasy football trade tools and attributed player-market research.

## Primary resources

- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/players — player values, history, usage, and downloadable data
- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/dynasty-rankings — current dynasty market rankings
- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/dynasty-trade-calculator — deterministic dynasty calculator
- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/methodology — calculator methodology
- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/data-sources — sources, rights, and update cadence
- https://www.fantasytradetarget.com/editorial-policy — fact, calculation, and interpretation policy

## Data notes

- Current public market values and player profiles are powered by Tradyr with attribution.
- Player photos are licensed Wikimedia Commons images with attribution on each page.
- Calculator verdicts are deterministic and do not use an AI model.
- The packaged public release is archived in FTT-owned market snapshots; league-specific advice and accepted-trade distributions are not yet included in player-page facts.
